sentences.text: ORDER Learned counsel for the petitioner has sought permission of the Court to withdraw the petition, with a liberty to approach the Sessions Court afresh under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. after examination of the victim.
2. Investigation is completed and charge sheet is already filed.
The petitioner is in judicial custody since 06.09.2023.

In the light of the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner,
petition is dismissed as withdrawn, reserving liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh petition before the Sessions Court after the victim's evidence is recorded.

Considering that the petitioner is in judicial custody, learned Sessions Judge is directed to expedite the recording of victim's evidence, keeping in view the relevant provisions of the POCSO Act, 2012.
